behavior.deadline_anchor: issue time of consumed single-use server challenge; not late packet receipt
behavior.after_stop_or_reconnect: new page where required and new deliberate press; stale arm/hold cannot restart
behavior.stop_type: EN zero, both direction inputs LOW; free coast, not active braking

live_serial.scope: Live post-upload diagnostics; digitalRead is not measured voltage/current or proof of physical wiring.

limitations: Physical timing, motion and direction of assembled car remain unverified.
IRQ timer tolerates ordinary blocking WiFi calls; CPU lockup or long-disabled interrupts are not covered.
Real phone/modem latency can expire the lease early; no live motor command was sent by agent.
Motor electrical ratings unknown; new battery/solder purchases do not prove replacement or soldered contacts.
New physical user trial reports intermittent start/buzzing; success is not established. Later serial read observes watchdog expiry but cannot distinguish ARMED from RUNNING expiry.
workspace_policy: Personal /home/novakj/3d-print; no Brain/global-memory changes, no commit or push.

subsequent_user_trial.source: User report relayed from originating voice task
subsequent_user_trial.reported_symptom: Po nasazení střechy se téměř nerozjede, vydává divný zvuk, jen někdy se rozjede.
subsequent_user_trial.lubrication: Uživatel namazal hřídelky silikonovým olejem, hlásí malý/nepozorovaný přínos; výrobek a měření neznámé.
subsequent_user_trial.wheels_lifted_trial: User explicitly reports no start with wheels lifted; do not repeat this question.
reported_chronology: Jirka dodatečně upřesnil, že těžký rozjezd nastal už se starým pulzním programem.
Nové ovládání při držení zpočátku vnímal jako perfektně funkční.
Potom hlásil bzučení a občasné rozběhy po montáži.
Po vyzkoušení s koly ve vzduchu hlásí, že motor teď vůbec nerozběhne ani bez zátěže.

subsequent_read_only_diagnostics.counter_scope: Counts expiration in ARMED as well as RUNNING. Not a count of measured physical motor stops.
subsequent_read_only_diagnostics.inference: Expiration is observed; Wi-Fi/browser delay can exhaust the 500ms challenge deadline. Physical cause and relative contribution versus load/power remain unproven.
subsequent_read_only_diagnostics.specific_interval_inference: At uptime221025ms: IDLE, HTTP35/closed35, watchdog4. At226033ms: IDLE, HTTP36/closed36, watchdog5. One request from IDLE can only arm; running needs another HOLD. Thus this particular observed expiration was ARMED, inferred from log and matching source; whether browser sent HOLD or it was delayed is unknown. Not a direct URL trace or explanation of every buzzing attempt.

physical_motor_test_evidence: Uživatel po novém uploadu hlásí neúspěšný/nespolehlivý pokus (subsequent_user_trial). Úspěšné držení/uvolnění, přesné fyzické časování ani jízda nejsou potvrzeny.

subsequent_unloaded_observation.method: Existing nonmotor ? serial diagnostic query every1.1seconds; no reset or firmware/upload change.
subsequent_unloaded_observation.limitation: No user request arrived during this observation. Cannot synchronize a claimed button hold to a motor ON state. Snapshot spacing cannot exclude shorter intervals in other runs.

bounded_refresh_observation.scope: No refreshed page/press reached this server during observation; physical press timing and phone UI state unknown.

latency_simulation.arm_reply_400ms: firstHOLD leaves100ms lease; next200ms HOLD is too late
latency_simulation.conclusion: Reproduces timing sensitivity, not proof of the real-world cause.
